Nina CSM: Heads-up — CobaltTech just told Omar procurement paused the PO while GC runs a compliance spot-check. Renewal in ~5 weeks. We saw a 72% drop in integration calls this week after they rotated keys. Need a short remediation + retention play.
Omar AE: Procurement flagged two things: 1) they want a formal export of 45 days of request metadata for audit, 2) concerns about telemetry SDKs that call external trackers. They also asked whether we can guarantee no live user PII is in those exports.
Priya (Cobalt PM): Sorry, GC is being cautious. They asked for an interim compliance pack and a minimal MSA addendum showing limited subprocessors and retention terms. Also asked for a quick runbook showing how we would restore service safely if they re-enable keys.
Devon Support: Ticket #5048 opened for key rotation fallout. Error summary: clients got 401 until key refresh; there was also an intermittent 502 spike on 2026-03-18 12:30Z. Logs excerpt: ```[2026-03-18T12:31:02Z] WARN 502 backend unavailable model-queue-saturated```
Rachel SE: Proposed tech deliverables: (a) sanitized 45-day request export (PII redacted + schema), (b) an export verification checklist for GC, (c) short note on telemetry libraries we use and opt-out controls. I can prepare the sanitized sample and the checkbox.
Nina CSM: Suggested commercial levers: 1) offer a 30-day usage credit while GC reviews, 2) provide a one-week technical concierge to help re-enable keys, 3) a limited-scope addendum that narrows subprocessors. Any objections? :thinking_face:
Omar AE: I'm ok with the credit and concierge. Pricing unchanged. We should ask contracts-bot to draft a narrow addendum (no pricing changes) that includes retention and subprocessors language.
contracts-bot: Draft addendum uploaded: https://files.redwood.dev/addendum/cobalttech-v0.2.pdf
Priya (Cobalt PM): GC also wants confirmation of encryption-in-transit + at-rest and a brief note about KMS ownership. Can you include that, Rachel?
Rachel SE: Yes — will include KMS ownership statement (customer key option) and a short encryption section. Also will attach the sanitized log sample. ETA 6 hours.
Devon Support: I've added the 502 analysis to ticket #5048 and a mitigation note (scaled workers + throttling tweak). Link: https://support.redwood.dev/tickets/5048
Nina CSM: Plan for the next 48h: A) Rachel uploads sanitized 45-day sample + checklist, B) contracts-bot iterates addendum with KMS/encryption snippet, C) Omar offers the 30-day credit + concierge in writing, D) schedule a short GC call if they request. I'll send a calendar hold for Thu 10:00 PT.
Omar AE: I'll email procurement now and confirm the credit + concierge; will CC Nina.
Priya (Cobalt PM): If we can get the materials before Thu call GC may do a quick review and lift the pause. Appreciated.
Nina CSM: Thanks all. I'll update thread when uploads are in. Next steps logged and I'll follow up with Cobalt procurement after Omar's note. :white_check_mark:
